• Adolescent girls and young women in eastern and southern Africa have histori-
cally faced the highest risk of acquiring HIV.

• Over the past two decades, HIV infections among young women in Uganda have
declined sharply, but the reasons for this decline are not fully understood.

• Both biomedical interventions (such as HIV treatment and male circumci-
sion) and changes in sexual behavior (such as later age at first sex) occurred
during this period, making it important to understand their individual and
combined effects.
